set.body:
TimebaseRepair.scala:165-166 says clockRepairs gives core's mapping vocabulary "its first production caller". It has none: every caller is a test (verified 2026-09-18). A Scaladoc asserting a false property of the code is exactly what this repository's evidence discipline exists to prevent.

Do now, independent of the rest of bd-01M2WTGF981AY7RCN8QC42JSPT: rewrite the sentence to say what is true (the repair is built and tested; production does not yet route through it; see the parent). When the parent lands the original claim becomes true and can be restored.

Accept: the sentence is true at HEAD. Tiny.
set.title: C1: the clockRepairs Scaladoc claims a production caller that does not exist -- make it true or remove it
